# goodbye.bg

> Free background remover that runs in the browser. Photos are cut out on the device, not on a server. The result is a see-through PNG of the subject, in high resolution, with no account and no watermark. A replacement for remove.bg, which shuts down on 1 December 2026.

- Open %SITE%/ and add photos with Choose photos, Paste, or a drop. Each photo becomes a card; Download saves the cut-out.
- Takes JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, TIFF, camera RAW, SVG, animated GIF and ZIP files.
- The model downloads once (about 120 MB) and runs on the GPU (WebGPU) or the CPU (WebAssembly).

## Pages

- [remove.bg alternative](%SITE%/remove-bg-alternative/): how goodbye.bg compares and what changes when remove.bg closes
- [How to remove a background](%SITE%/how-to-remove-background/): step by step
- [Bulk background remover](%SITE%/bulk-background-remover/): many photos at once, Download all as a zip
- [Remove the background from a GIF](%SITE%/remove-background-from-gif/): animated GIFs, frame by frame
- [Source](https://github.com/kevinebaugh/goodbye.bg): AGPL-3.0
